tools.name: extract_url
tools.description: Fetch a web page (blog post, product page, recipe...) and return its title, description, site name and up to 10 image URLs, ready to put on a pin.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List the pin templates, optionally for one category. Each entry says whether it shows a subtitle (the description) and which extra fields it supports, such as a price or cook time.

tools.name: list_styles
tools.description: List the color palettes (with their hex colors) and font pairings a pin can use.

tools.name: get_quota
tools.description: How many pin renders the user has left today. The limit resets at 00:00 UTC.

tools.name: render_pin
tools.description: Render a 1000x1500 Pinterest pin and return a preview plus a link to the full image (JPEG by default). The link expires after 7 days. The result also has an edit_url. When a short title looks small for its space, re-render with text_size "auto". When a photo is cropped badly or too small in its frame, re-render with image_focus, image_zoom or image_fit "contain". Counts against the daily render limit; failed renders are not counted. The result has a warnings list (each with a code and a message) when something looks wrong. Read it, but re-render only when a warning matters. Codes: TITLE_CLAMPED, DESCRIPTION_CUT, IMAGE_CROPPED, IMAGE_UPSCALED, TITLE_SHRUNK, TITLE_SMALL, SUBTITLE_HIDDEN, EXTRA_IMAGES_IGNORED, IMAGE_IGNORED, LAYOUT_UNSETTLED.

description.description: Shown as the subtitle on templates that support one

image_url.description: Main image, e.g. one returned by extract_url

additional_image_urls.description: Extra images for collage and multi-image templates, up to 3 (Photo Stack and Photo Quad show four photos)

site_name.description: Shown as the domain line, e.g. "myblog.com"

show_description.description: Default: true when a description is given

show_site_name.description: Default: true when a site name is given

custom_fields.description: Template-specific fields from list_templates, e.g. {"price": "$19"}. Only the fields given are shown; omitted or blank ones are left off. number-badge and side-panels always show a number: pass listNumber.

text_size.description: Text size for the whole pin, in percent (70-250), or "auto". 100 is the template's normal size. "auto" instead fits the title to its space: a short title is made larger, as far as its area allows, and it is never smaller than normal. It cannot be combined with title_size, and the other text keeps its size.

title_size.description: Extra size for the title only, in percent (70-150), applied on top of text_size. Default 100.

description_size.description: Extra size for the description only, in percent (70-150), applied on top of text_size. Default 100.

cta_size.description: Extra size for the button text only, in percent (70-150), applied on top of text_size. Default 100.

site_name_size.description: Extra size for the site name only, in percent (70-150), applied on top of text_size. Default 100.

format.description: Default and recommended: jpeg (about 0.3 MB). Use png only if the user asks for it.

image_focus.description: Which part of the photo to keep in view when it is cropped: center, top, bottom, left, right, or { "x": 0.5, "y": 0.3 } with each from 0 (left/top) to 1 (right/bottom). Default center.

image_zoom.description: Enlarges the photo inside its frame around image_focus, in percent (100-200). Default 100. For a small product in a big frame; it makes a small photo look softer.

image_fit.description: cover (default) fills the frame and crops the photo; contain shows the whole photo with the palette's secondary color in the empty bars.
